title: RAG Chunk Schema
description: Data contracts for the AI Solution Architect RAG layer. Rule-based, no LLM evaluation.

Chunk.description: A single ingested text chunk from the knowledge base.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the chunk.

source.description: Origin file path or document title.

page.description: Source page number (0/1-based per ingestion convention).

box.description: Semantic bucket (1-3). Assigned during ingestion based on the source directory.

RetrievalResponse.description: Filtered list of retrieved chunks returned by search_patterns(). Ordered best (lowest distance) first.

distance.description: Chroma distance metric. Lower = better match. Chunks with distance > DISTANCE_THRESHOLD are discarded.
